entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: Old-fashioned head of the Varma family of Avishkar, former Consul and father of Sita.

entities.name: Sita Varma
entities.description: Mohar's daughter, secret street racer and captain of Avishkar's team.

entities.name: Madhu
entities.description: Mohar's wife, who died in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who broke into Mohar's house to offer help overthrowing the Assembly.

entities.name: Rudra
entities.description: Friend of Mohar in charge of security at the Grand Prix.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: Thought too focused on managing the race to notice the coup.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Former ruling body Mohar belonged to.

entities.name: Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: Ruling body Mohar sought to overthrow.

entities.name: Indigo Revolution
entities.description: Revolution after which Mohar lost his stature.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: Race on whose first day Mohar's coup was planned.

events.summary: Madhu dies in the New Phyrexian Invasion, leaving Mohar to raise Sita alone.
events.quote: Madhu died in the New Phyrexian Invasion , leaving Mohar to raise his daughter alone.

events.summary: On the first day of the second Ghirapur Grand Prix, Jace and Vraska break into Mohar's house offering to help him reinstall the Consulate.
events.quote: Jace Beleren and Vraska broke into his house, claiming that they wanted to help him overthrow the Avishkar Assembly and reinstall the Consulate.

events.summary: Mohar recruits Harshad and Rudra to trap the racers at the finish line and retake Kaladesh.
events.quote: The plan was to lay a trap for the racers at the finish line and retake Kaladesh while everybody was watching.

events.summary: The trap stops the leading teams and reveals Sita as captain; the coup fails and Mohar is jailed.
events.quote: it failed, and Mohar was sent to jail.

relations.quote: and the father of Sita Varma .
